description: Synthetic Celia numerical reference; one ice-free 0.6 m soil column with 100 cells. Original physical parameters, initial state, forcing and prescribed-head boundaries preserved. Derived IDA decisions: num_method=ida, nrgConserv=closedForm, infRateMax=topmodel_GA; numerical absTolMatric=relTolMatric=1e-8. Matric heads compared with independent input-only finite-volume Richards integrations, not the legacy solver output. No basin, coupled-chain or general multiphysics validation.
source: Knoben, W. J. M.; Clark, M. P.; Nijssen, B.; Wood, A. W.; Bennett, A. (2023). SUMMA v3.x Test Cases, HydroShare. https://www.hydroshare.org/resource/e4df3065264341a48017f6d2f4ad030c/ Archive SHA256 35a66bd3fadf3e4cd3a1ba4a1fcc328b8d69c06f1264a29068751da25e23d829
license: CC-BY-4.0 https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/; generated reference and generator CC0-1.0; source input attribution retained
expectations: one timestep NetCDF with 120 half-hourly times from 2000-01-01 00:30
one HRU and GRU, HRU ID equal to attributes, 100 soil layers
mLayerMatricHead dimensions exactly (time, midSoil, hru), units m, finite and unmasked
all 120x100 matric heads agree with independent converged Richards reference
tolerance_rationale: Date conversion permits 0.1 ms; forcing permits float32 output roundoff. Independent temporal refinement and Radau/BDF agreement are below 7.3e-9 m; 1e-4 m absolute plus 1e-6 relative allows the explicitly configured IDA error and the simplified isothermal reference discrepancy, while rejecting a local 1 mm perturbation. This is a declared fixture acceptance budget, not a rigorous error bound for other cases. See containers/hydrology/NUMERICAL-REFERENCES.md.
